knowledge.description: Explore our initiatives advancing knowledge, dialogue, and evidence-based policymaking.

items.title: Advisory Initiative on Sustainable Logistics and Supply Chain Decarbonization
items.preview: Regional stakeholders aligned freight emissions targets with national climate commitments through structured dialogue. The program yields practical roadmaps for fleet renewal, routing efficiency, and multimodal infrastructure investment.

items.title: Green Energy Transition Frameworks for Developing Nations
items.preview: This synthesis distills global experience on grid stability, storage integration, and equitable tariff design for emerging economies. It emphasizes phased renewable deployment while safeguarding reliability and universal energy access.

items.title: Inclusive Digital Economy: Protecting Vulnerable Workers
items.preview: Platform-based work is reshaping labor markets faster than many safeguards can adapt across jurisdictions. The brief outlines monitoring priorities, grievance pathways, and partnership models that protect informal and gig workers.

items.title: Transparency in Public Procurement: A Modern Approach
items.preview: Open contracting principles are paired with audit-ready data standards and civic monitoring hooks. Pilots show measurable reductions in discretion risk while shortening vendor onboarding cycles for legitimate suppliers.

items.title: Circular Economy Policy Blueprints
items.preview: Material flows are mapped from design through reuse to identify high-leverage regulatory and incentive levers. Municipal and industry partners co-develop pilots that cut landfill pressure without dampening SME competitiveness.

items.title: Targeting Without Exclusion: Lessons from Social Registry Pilots
